chapter: Ellington, singers, the book and closing
title: Ivy Anderson and why good jazz singers are scarce
summary: Singers do not go to jam sessions, so they do not learn jazz.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah. What did you think of Ivy Anderson, by the way?
I heard her not too long ago, man. I liked her.
Oh, I'm thinking about somebody else. I liked (unintelligible).
Yeah, I always thought she was the best singer that he ever had.
Why do you suppose it is that -- I mean, you can find a certain number of tenor players or trumpet players or whatever, why is it so hard to find a singer?
Because they don't listen to jazz. You got to go do singing in jam sessions to (unintelligible). go out and go to jam sessions where people are singing.
